$comment: VAPP-85: the token NAMES the core catalog's macros and Box styles reference as `$<group>.<name>` (e.g. `$color.primary`, `$spacing.md`). VALUES come from a theme (VAPP-92); this file only fixes the vocabulary. `color` = the shadcn semantic set plus success/warning/info and the eight chart hues (round 1 added chart6..8); `spacing`/`radius`/`type` mirror packages/design-tokens' scales by NAME (xl2 because 2xl is not an identifier in Swift/Kotlin/Rust); `control` = the per-kind control heights the VAPP-4 spike asked for instead of px (round 1 adds `appBar`, `tabBar`, `toast`); `shadow` = the boxShadow presets, ALSO the elevation scale (none < sm < md < lg < xl: flat, card, popover, dialog, toast; paint order inside a layer stays tree order, overlays stack by layer, never by zIndex); `opacity` = the text-emphasis ladder; VAPP-92 adds `border` (the border-width ladder, px) and `motion` (durations, ms). Round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md) adds `breakpoint` (px, the ONLY tokens a style CONDITION may reference: `"@media (min-width: $breakpoint.md)"`; resolved against the theme before matching), `ease` (cubic-bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2], referenced by `transitionEasing`) and `density` (multipliers over `control` and `spacing` for the surface density `compact`/`comfortable`; `default` = 1, never a token). Round 2 (docs/round-2-contract.md §2) adds `blur` (px radii, the ONLY values `backdropBlur` takes). Every group is append-only: a theme is validated against these names.
